policy.title: Privacy Policy
policy.fullNotice: This offline summary does not replace the current published Privacy Policy.

s1.title: 1. What data we collect
s1.p1: • Account data: phone, email when provided, username, name, 16+ confirmation, photo, biography, interests and optional social links.
s1.p2: • Content and activity: rooms and participation, direct/group/room messages, voice messages, houses, follows, reactions and reports.
s1.p3: • Metadata: creation date, last login, followers list, interests, platform role.
s1.p4: • Precise or approximate location, optional and off by default: users who enable visibility appear on the real-time map. Turning visibility off clears coordinates.
s1.p5: • Payments and technical data: Stripe history, IP address, security logs and device identifiers needed for push notifications.

s2.title: 2. Why we collect them
s2.p1: • Provide the service: create an account, join rooms, exchange messages.
s2.p2: • Moderation: reports, suspensions and bans (legitimate interest — community safety).
s2.p3: • Notifications: inform about invitations, starting rooms, received messages (you can disable them in settings).
s2.p4: • Optional Sentry mobile diagnostics: off by default, no default PII, and enabled only after revocable consent.

s3.title: 3. Who we share them with
s3.p2: • Necessary providers: hosting and private object storage, Twilio (SMS), Firebase/APNs (push), LiveKit (live audio), Stripe (payments), Sentry (consented diagnostics), Resend/email delivery, and the map/tile provider enabled on your platform.
s3.p3: • In case of legal obligation, judicial requisition or protection of a person in danger.

s4.title: 4. How long
s4.p1: • Profile and content: as long as your account is active.
s4.p2: • Account deletion: 30 days grace period, then definitive purge.
s4.p3: • Database audit log: 90 days by default; expired authentication artefacts are removed on short schedules.
s4.p4: • Narrow financial, security or legal records may be isolated and retained only for periods required by law.

s5.title: 5. Your rights (GDPR)
s5.p1: • Access and portability: export all your data via Settings → Privacy → Export my data.
s5.p2: • Rectification: modify your profile at any time.
s5.p3: • Erasure: delete your account (Settings → Privacy → Delete my account).
s5.p4: • Opposition: disable notifications, location sharing, or crash reporting from settings.
s5.p5: • Complaint: you can contact the competent data-protection supervisory authority for your situation.

s6.title: 6. Security
s6.p1: • Passwords and OTP codes stored in hashed form (bcrypt).
s6.p2: • Authentication tokens stored in the secure keychain of the phone.
s6.p3: • All network exchanges are encrypted in HTTPS/TLS. Audio streams are encrypted in DTLS-SRTP.

s7.title: 7. Contact
s7.p1: Use the verified privacy contact shown in the complete published policy.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.fullNotice: This offline summary does not replace the current published Terms of Use.

s1.title: 1. Acceptance
s1.p1: By creating an account or using the ChatHouse app, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service.

s2.title: 2. Eligibility
s2.p1: You must be at least 16 years old to create or use a ChatHouse account. Registration by anyone under 16 is not permitted.
s2.p2: • Do not share illegal, explicit, or copyright-infringing content.
s2.p3: • Built-in room recording is disabled. Do not make an external recording without the explicit consent of everyone concerned.

s3.title: 3. Prohibited Conduct
s3.p1: • Harassment, discrimination, hate speech, non-consensual explicit content, child sexual exploitation or abuse, and child sexual abuse material.
s3.p2: • Identity theft, fake accounts, unauthorized automation (bots).
s3.p3: • Broadcast of copyrighted works without rights, illegal content.
s3.p4: • Spam, phishing, social engineering, vulnerability exploitation.
s3.p5: • Recording a room without explicit consent from all participants.

s4.title: 4. Moderation
s4.p1: We may restrict content or features, end a room, or suspend or delete an account that violates the rules. Notice or an appeal path is provided where appropriate and legally required.
s4.p2: You can report a user or a room directly in the interface.

s5.title: 5. User Content
s5.p1: You retain full rights to the content you publish. You grant us a non-exclusive license for storage and broadcast strictly necessary for service operation.
s5.p2: Account termination ends this license (except content already received by others via direct messages).

s6.title: 6. Limitation of Liability
s6.p1: The service is provided 'as is'. We do not guarantee uninterrupted availability, nor that all user-published content is lawful.

s7.title: 7. Modifications
s7.p1: These terms may evolve. Material changes will use a new version and be communicated before taking effect as required by law; renewed acceptance will be requested where required.

s8.title: 8. Governing Law
s8.p1: These terms are governed by the law and dispute provisions stated in the current published Terms of Use. Mandatory consumer protections and jurisdiction rights in your country remain unaffected.
